paragraphs.text: Taeko , also known as the Patient Avalanche , is a turtlefolk ninja (possibly Kappa ) from an unknown plane.

Taeko is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Blue Ninjas deck . Due to his type, he is potentially a kappa from Kamigawa though this is not confirmed. He is a large humanoid turtle thats wears wooden armor, a cloth bandana with eye holes over his face, and has a blue flame coming off the top of his head.
